title: Test case 11 — A company's unguarded conveyor (occupational health and safety; a body corporate is fined)
shows: A body corporate as the offender: no ages and no questions about a person; no imprisonment, CCO or other order on a person (app policy); the maximum is a fine, and a company's maximum is the one the register prints for a body corporate (9,000 penalty units, against 1,800 for a person); a fine above it is an error.
